# ONLYOFFICE DocSpace: Embed SDK

> Embed DocSpace in your web app: the full workspace, a room, a document editor or viewer, or a file picker.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/llms.txt).

## Get Started

- [Introduction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace Embed SDK, based on JavaScript, lets you embed DocSpace directly inside your web application. You can integrate a full document workspace, a standalone editor, a file picker, or a background authentication frame — with just a few lines of code.
- [Quickstart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/get-started/quickstart.md): Before you begin, make sure you meet the prerequisites.
- [Playground](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/get-started/playground.md): The Playground serves as an interactive platform for users to explore and test the capabilities of the ONLYOFFICE DocSpace Embed SDK without registration and installing anything. It provides users with various embedding modes, allowing them to experiment with different DocSpace configurations seamlessly.
- [Authentication & Security](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/get-started/authentication-security.md): How authentication works in the DocSpace Embed SDK and how to configure your integration securely.

## Embedding modes

- [Manager mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/manager-mode.md): Manager mode embeds the full DocSpace interface inside your application, including rooms, folders, files, navigation, and settings. It is the most complete embedding mode and gives users an entire DocSpace window without having to leave the application.
- [Viewer mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/viewer-mode.md): Viewer mode embeds a read-only document inside your application. It opens a file by ID and renders it in a non-editable state, allowing users to read and review documents without exposing editing controls. If you want users to have editing controls, use the Editor mode instead.
- [Editor mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/editor-mode.md): Editor mode embeds a fully functional document editor inside your application. It opens a file by ID and gives the users all document editor capabilities like real-time co-authoring, comments, and track changes, depending on the user's DocSpace permissions.
- [Room selector mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/room-selector-mode.md): Room selector mode integrates a room picker interface inside your application. It presents users with a list of DocSpace rooms and returns the selected room's data via a callback function. If you are looking to embed a fully functional DocSpace interface, check out the Manager mode and Frame mode.
- [File selector mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/file-selector-mode.md): File selector mode integrates a file picker interface inside your application. It allows users to view, browse and select from a list of DocSpace files. The selected file's data is returned via a callback function.
- [System mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/system-mode.md): System mode initializes a lightweight, hidden SDK frame that displays a blank page with a loader. It renders no visible DocSpace UI. Instead, it provides access to a focused set of system-level methods for managing user sessions programmatically, such as authentication, hash generation, and user info retrieval — without embedding a visible interface.
- [Uploader mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/uploader-mode.md): Uploader mode embeds a file upload interface inside your application. It targets a specific DocSpace folder by ID and lets users upload files directly into it, with optional controls over accepted file types and multi-file selection.
- [Frame mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/embedding-modes/frame-mode.md): The Frame mode is a general-purpose initialization method. Using initFrame() leaves the mode configurable, allowing you to load any other mode at runtime using the mode parameter. By default, initFrame() runs in the Manager mode.

## SDK usage

- [Classes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/classes.md): The classes an integration works with. SDK creates frames and keeps them in a registry, SDKInstance drives one embedded iframe and exposes the methods that call into it.
- [SDK](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/classes/SDK.md): The SDK class is responsible for managing multiple SDKInstance objects.
- [SDKInstance](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/classes/SDKInstance.md): Represents an SDK instance for managing frames and communicating with DocSpace.
- [Type Aliases](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases.md): Configuration, event, filter and data shapes exchanged with the embedded frame. Most integrations only need TFrameConfig and TFrameEvents; the remaining types describe what the instance methods accept and return.
- [TBannerDisplaying](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TBannerDisplaying.md): The template literal type for the display options of the header banner.
- [TEditorCustomization](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TEditorCustomization.md): The editor customization configuration.
- [TEditorType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TEditorType.md): The template literal type based on the EditorType enum.
- [TEventReturnData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TEventReturnData.md): The event return data structure.
- [TFilterSortBy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TFilterSortBy.md): The template literal type representing the filter sort options.
- [TFilterSortOrder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TFilterSortOrder.md): The template literal type representing the filter sort order.
- [TFrameConfig](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TFrameConfig.md): The frame configuration.
- [TFrameEvents](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TFrameEvents.md): The frame event handlers.
- [TFrameFilter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TFrameFilter.md): The frame filter criteria.
- [TFrameMode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TFrameMode.md): The template literal type representing the frame mode based on SDKMode.
- [TManagerViewMode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TManagerViewMode.md): The template literal type representing the manager view mode.
- [TMessageData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TMessageData.md): The message data structure.
- [TMessageTypes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TMessageTypes.md): The template literal type for message types.
- [TSelectorType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TSelectorType.md): The template literal type for the selector filters.
- [TTask](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TTask.md): The task object structure.
- [TTheme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/type-aliases/TTheme.md): The template literal type representing the theme options.
- [Enumerations](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations.md): Typed constants for frame modes, themes, editor layouts and sort options. Use them in place of the raw string values they stand for.
- [EditorType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/EditorType.md): The available types of editor interface.
- [FilterSortBy](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/FilterSortBy.md): The criteria for filtering and sorting items.
- [FilterSortOrder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/FilterSortOrder.md): The item sorting order.
- [HeaderBannerDisplaying](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/HeaderBannerDisplaying.md): The display settings of the header banner.
- [InstanceMethods](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/InstanceMethods.md): Available instance methods in the SDK for file management, user information, and settings.
- [ManagerViewMode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/ManagerViewMode.md): The view modes available in the manager.
- [MessageTypes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/MessageTypes.md): The types of messages exchanged between SDK components and the host application.
- [SDKMode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/SDKMode.md): The available modes for initializing the SDK.
- [SelectorFilterType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/SelectorFilterType.md): The filter type used in the selector views.
- [Theme](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/enumerations/Theme.md): The available application themes.
- [Variables](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/variables.md): Exported constants: the default frame configuration, the iframe name prefix, the CSP validation endpoint and the error messages the SDK shows.
- [connectErrorText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/variables/connectErrorText.md): The error message displayed when the message bus fails to connect with the embedded frame.
- [CSPApiUrl](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/variables/CSPApiUrl.md): The API endpoint for managing Content Security Policy (CSP) settings.
- [cspErrorText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/variables/cspErrorText.md): The error message displayed when the current domain is not included in the CSP settings.
- [defaultConfig](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/variables/defaultConfig.md): The default configuration object for initializing and embedding a DocSpace frame.
- [FRAME\_NAME](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/usage-sdk/variables/FRAME_NAME.md): The default name for the DocSpace iframe element.

## Samples

- [Add tags to room](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/add-tags-to-room.md): Add custom tags to a DocSpace room using the JS SDK.

- [Create password hash](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/create-hash.md): Generate a password hash using the DocSpace JS SDK.
- [Create room](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/create-room.md): Create a new shared room using the DocSpace JS SDK.
- [Create tag](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/create-tag.md): Create a custom tag in DocSpace using the JS SDK.
- [Destroy frame](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/destroy-frame.md): Remove the embedded DocSpace iframe using the JS SDK.
- [Get config](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-config.md): Retrieve the embedded frame configuration using the JS SDK.
- [Get files and folders list](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-files-and-folders-list.md): Retrieve files and folders from a room using the JS SDK.
- [Get files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-files.md): Retrieve a list of files from a room using the JS SDK.
- [Get folder info](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-folder-info.md): Retrieve current folder information using the JS SDK.
- [Get folders](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-folders.md): Retrieve a list of folders from a room using the JS SDK.
- [Get hash settings](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-hash-settings.md): Retrieve hash settings from the DocSpace frame using the JS SDK.
- [Get rooms](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-rooms.md): Retrieve available rooms using the DocSpace JS SDK.
- [Get selection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-selection.md): Retrieve the current selection in DocSpace using the JS SDK.
- [Get user info](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/get-user-info.md): Retrieve user information using the DocSpace JS SDK.
- [Initialize editor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-editor.md): Open a document in the DocSpace editor using the JS SDK.
- [Initialize file selector](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-file-selector.md): Initialize the DocSpace file selector using the JS SDK.
- [Initialize frame](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-frame.md): Initialize the DocSpace view-only frame using the JS SDK.
- [Initialize manager](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-manager.md): Initialize the DocSpace manager using the JS SDK.
- [Initialize room selector](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-room-selector.md): Embed the room selection interface using the JS SDK.
- [Initialize system](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-system.md): Initialize the DocSpace system interface using the JS SDK.
- [Initialize viewer](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/init-viewer.md): Embed a read-only document viewer using the JS SDK.
- [Login](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/login.md): Log in to DocSpace using the JS SDK with password hashing.
- [Logout](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/logout.md): Log out a user from the DocSpace session using the JS SDK.
- [Mark iframe as loaded](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/mark-iframe-as-loaded.md): Mark the DocSpace iframe as loaded using the JS SDK.
- [Open modal](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/open-modal.md): Open a modal window in DocSpace using the JS SDK.
- [Remove tags from room](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/remove-tags-from-room.md): Remove tags from a DocSpace room using the JS SDK.
- [Set config](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/set-config.md): Update the embedded frame configuration using the JS SDK.
- [Set list view](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/basic-samples/set-list-view.md): Change the file list display mode using the JS SDK.
- [Authorization](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/authorization.md): Log in to a DocSpace account using email and password hash.
- [Create basic task](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/basic-task-create.md): Create a task management table with auto-generated DocSpace rooms.
- [Create file in selected folder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/create-file-in-selected-folder.md): Create a file in a selected folder and open it in the editor.
- [Create a Tabbed DocSpace Manager UI](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/create-tabbed-docspace-manager.md): Embed DocSpace in a tabbed interface with multiple manager instances.
- [Customize editors](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/customize-editors.md): Customize the editor interface with branded buttons, logos, and links.
- [Draggable resizable modals](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/draggable-resizable-modals.md): Embed DocSpace in draggable and resizable modal windows.
- [File manager with task attachments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/file-manager-task-attachments.md): Attach files to tasks using a DocSpace file selector modal.
- [Collaborative project workflow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/freelance-platform-docspace.md): Build a freelance project workspace with rooms and file management.
- [DocSpace chat commands](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/insert-rooms-and-files-into-chat.md): Insert room and file links into a chat using slash commands.
- [Open file in ONLYOFFICE editors](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/open-file-in-onlyoffice-editors.md): Select a file and open it in ONLYOFFICE editors via the SDK.
- [Manage project folders](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/project-manager-folder-integration.md): Track projects as folders in a shared room with file locking.
- [Structured room creation](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/room-creation-with-folder-structure.md): Create client rooms with predefined folders and document templates.
- [Create files in rooms](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/task-file-create.md): Create tasks linked to DocSpace rooms and add files inside them.
- [Room selector](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/task-room-selector.md): Link tasks to DocSpace rooms using the room selector component.
- [Two-factor authentication](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/advanced-samples/two-factor-authentication.md): Verify users with a phone code before granting DocSpace access.
- [React component](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/javascript-sdk/samples/react-samples.md): Integrate ONLYOFFICE DocSpace into React projects.
